node.title: Quadratic MCA staircase and four exact prize rows
node.statement: For every RS row and every 0<=r<=n-k-1 satisfying (n-r)^2>=n(k+r), the full-field support-wise MCA bad-slope numerator is exactly r+1. Four explicit power-of-two subgroup rows, one at each official rate and with k=2^40, have exact target-2^-128 safe set [0,B/n), where B=floor(p/2^128); the largest safe grid radius is (B-1)/n and B/n is unsafe. These particular 167--171-bit prime rows do not determine the separately frozen near-capacity or rate-half razor rows and make no list claim.
